Follow these instructions to remove Thunderbird from your computer.

{for winxp}
#Go to the Windows Start menu and select {menu Control Panel}.
#Click on {menu Add or Remove Programs}.
#Select {menu Mozilla Thunderbird} from the list of programs. 
#Click {button Remove}. This will launch the uninstall wizard, which will guide you through the rest of the process.
{/for}
{for win7}
# Go to the Windows Start menu and select {menu Control Panel}.
#Click the {menu Uninstall a program} link under '''Programs'''.
#Select {menu Mozilla Thunderbird} from the list of programs. 
#Click the {menu Uninstall} option that appears at the top of the list. This will launch the uninstall wizard, which will guide you through the rest of the process.
{/for}
{for win8}
#From the Desktop version of Windows 8, move your mouse to the right edge of the screen to bring up the Charms menu, then click {menu Settings}.
#From the Settings menu, select {menu Control Panel}.
#Click the {menu Uninstall a program} link under '''Programs'''.
#Select {menu Mozilla Thunderbird} from the list of programs. 
#Click the {menu Uninstall} option that appears at the top of the list. This will launch the uninstall wizard, which will guide you through the rest of the process.
{/for}
{for win10}
#Click the Windows Start button or press the Windows key {key [[Image:Windows Key]]}.<!-- The next two steps are from Microsoft's article, http://windows.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-10/repair-or-remove-programs-->
#In the Start menu, select {menu Settings}.
#In Settings, select {menu System} and then {menu Apps & features}.
#Select {menu Mozilla Thunderbird} from the list of programs. 
#Click the {button Uninstall} button. This will launch the uninstall wizard, which will guide you through the rest of the process.
{/for}
{for mac}
#Open the {filepath Applications folder}.
#Click and drag the Thunderbird icon to Trash.
{/for}
{for linux}
#Open {menu Ubuntu Software Center} and click on the {menu Installed} icon.
#Expand the {menu Internet} section and click on {menu Thunderbird Mail} to highlight it. 
#Click on the {button Remove} button to the far right. Follow the instructions that pop up.
{/for}
